correctness.rationale: HEADLINE vs EVIDENCE. The emergent claim has four components; two verify, two fail. (1) May E1 core REPRODUCED: re-running inputs/artifacts/may_window.py gives 517 E1 monomials, d1^2=0 on single-generator monomials, anchors E2(1,1)=E2(1,4)=E2(2,12)=1; my independent reimplementation of the E1 enumeration (same stated conventions) confirms n_E1=517 and spot E1 counts E1(1,5)=1 ({a1}), E1(2,5)=1 ({a0*h10}), E1(6,40)=7, E1(8,41)=6. (2) H^*V(1)/Steenrod low-degree checks REPRODUCED: check_ext.py exits 0 with Poincare dims 0..9 = 1,1,0,0,1,2,1,0,1,2, matching my independent admissible-basis enumeration to degree 12. (3) CENSUS FALSE (headline component): enumerate.py claims 1,552,353 admissible monomials of degree<=41 with dim A_40=328,962, dim A_41=473,119. Its is_adm() has `return True` indented INSIDE the `while i<n:` loop (inputs/artifacts/enumerate.py line 55), so only the first factor-block is ever checked (demonstrated: the triple (P3,P1,B,P1), inadmissible at the beta-P1 triple, passes the buggy predicate). My independent full-admissibility DFS (prefix-pruned, verified against check_ext.py's correct predicate at low degrees) gives the TRUE census: 105 admissible monomials total of degree<=41, dim A_40=3, dim A_41=8. The reported figures are wrong by 4-5 orders of magnitude, and the downstream 'measured infeasibility wall / 10^5-10^6 matrices' conclusion (DRAFT 3.4, target_exit.json blocking obstacle) is therefore unsupported by the code's own output once corrected. (4) TWIST 'CERTIFICATE' IS ASSERTION, NOT COMPUTATION: twist_check.py computes nothing — it prints a hardcoded JSON string (no import of May data, no homology computation). The underlying E1 facts it cites (E1(1,5)={a1}, d1(a1)=0, E2(2,5) dim 1) are true under the script's conventions (confirmed via (1)), so the inference 'naive twist has d^2(e0)=-a0*h10*e5 with no canceling source in-window' follows, but the file itself verifies nothing and the 'obstruction' is a property of the authors' own ad hoc naive twist definition, not of V(1). (5) UNDISCLOSED BOUNDARY EFFECT: may_window.py drops products with s>8 (mul truncation). d1 raises s by 1, so all E2 dims at s=8 — including headlined E2(8,41)=6 — have outgoing differentials to s=9 silently discarded and are upper bounds, yet DRAFT claims them as exact 'full E2 page' entries with no caveat. A false headline number plus an overstated exactness claim plus an assertion-only certificate = correctness FAIL.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route: the package genuinely arose from the target's May-log leg (R1a/R1b/R1d) plus the twist attempt (R1e), documented in target_exit_request.json before any fallback was pursued, so it is not a swapped-in replacement; judged on the ordinary standard with no presumption. Fused live search (3 consolidated directions, full provider coverage, partial=false, 20 deduplicated results) plus the admission record's two-round search surfaces only: general machinery (Belmont-Kong 2025 multiplicative Moss/Toda convergence; Dugger-Isaksen 2010 and Hu-Kriz-Ormsby motivic ASS construction/convergence), a different spectral sequence (Shimomura 1997 L2-localized V(1) ANSS E10=Einf with d5/d9; Shimomura 1996 beta-family; Carrick-Davies 2024 synthetic v2 nonvanishing), and background pages (nLab May/ASS, theses). No surfaced source tabulates a from-scratch p=3 May E2 table to t=41 with these entries, no source states the authors' naive-twist a0*h10 observation (it concerns their own definition, so no prior could), and no database row records these artifacts. The May E2 mathematical method is of course classical (May 1964; Ravenel), but no retrieved prior substantively implies or exhaustively covers the exact submitted artifacts, so originality narrowly PASSES; the recomputation-without-novelty concern is decided under value, where it belongs.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING gets no value presumption. The admitted target (classical d2 at (34,6)) and the preset fallback (motivic d2=0 at (34,6,17)) are both explicitly NOT achieved — DRAFT states this honestly. What remains is: (i) a machine table of sphere May E2 dims to t=41 at p=3 with only 3 textbook anchors checked and no comparison against any published May/Ext chart, i.e. an unvalidated recomputation of classical data and an unexplained enumeration; (ii) the observation that the authors' own naive tensor-product twist definition fails d^2=0 — an expected consequence of V(1) not being a ring, i.e. an implementation-log failure of a self-made definition, not an exact invariant of a natural object established for future retrieval; (iii) low-degree algebra self-consistency checks (Poincare to degree 9, 40 associativity spot checks), i.e. textbook/implementation material; (iv) a census that is both false (see correctness) and, once corrected (105 monomials), trivial rather than a quantified wall. No new theorem, no reusable lemma constraining any open differential, no chart correction, no downstream use is demonstrated; the 'redirect future attacks' moral restates the known fact that V(1) May computations need the cofiber extension data. This is textbook restatement + unexplained enumeration + implementation log even taken as correct and new, and the single potentially load-bearing component (the measured wall) is false. Intrinsic low value / missing substantive result => value FAIL.

residual_risks: E2 homology dims (e.g. E2(6,40)=5) were reproduced only at the E1-enumeration level plus anchors; the full per-(s,t) homology computation including Koszul signs was not independently reimplemented, so additional sign or truncation bugs beyond the s=8 boundary effect cannot be excluded.

May conventions (generator degrees, d1 formula, polynomial-vs-exterior structure) were checked for plausibility and anchor agreement only, not line-by-line against a published reference; a convention error would shift the whole table.

True admissible census (105 total; A_40=3, A_41=8) rests on my independent DFS implementing the standard admissibility predicate (cross-validated against check_ext.py's correct predicate at degrees<=9); a subtle excess-condition subtlety for P^a-beta-P^b triples could perturb counts, but cannot bridge the 4-order-of-magnitude gap to the claimed 1.55M.

Originality PASS is narrow (no covering source surfaced); a published p=3 May E2 chart to stem 34+ that the fused search missed would convert the table entries into textbook recomputation, reinforcing the REJECT via originality as well.
